title: Rōti Modern Mediterranean — Forsyth Town Center Tenant Build-Out
size: 2,124 SF restaurant at 3125 Ronald Reagan Parkway, Suite 912B
developer: Rōti Modern Mediterranean / Forsyth Town Center (Fuqua Development)
timing: Rōti's South Forsyth lease was publicly reported September 11, 2026. No opening or construction start has been announced, making this an early pursuit window for local restaurant-TI contractors to identify the landlord/tenant GC and get in front of HVAC, hood/ventilation, plumbing, electrical, fire-protection and finish packages before build-out is substantially committed.
source: North Atlanta Star — Rōti Modern Mediterranean Plans South Forsyth Restaurant at New Whole Foods Center

title: Barnes & Noble — The Forum Peachtree Corners Relocation / TI
size: Approximately 15,000 SF relocation within The Forum, into the former Old Navy space
developer: Barnes & Noble / The Forum Peachtree Corners (Jamestown-managed property)
timing: Barnes & Noble set January 27, 2027 as the opening date for its relocated store. The Forum's public directory describes an approximately 15,000-SF revamped model with modern fixtures, furniture, updated finishes and an in-store café. Local TI contractors should confirm the active GC and remaining MEP, lighting, millwork, fixture, café-plumbing and closeout packages.
source: North Atlanta Star / The Forum Peachtree Corners

title: Mansell Place & Highway 9 — Traffic Signal Installation
size: Intersection improvement including a new traffic signal, crosswalk and road striping; project cost not yet published
timing: The project entered permitting by August 31, 2026 and is listed by True North 400 as a 2026 Quick Win. No bid date or construction start is posted yet. Signal/electrical and civil contractors should track True North 400 and City of Roswell procurement for the first construction solicitation or prime-contractor announcement.

title: First Baptist Church Cumming — Commercial Renovation / Build-Out
size: Commercial church renovation/build-out at 1597 Sawnee Drive; detailed square footage not public in accessible listing
timing: PlanHub lists bids due September 14, 2026. This remains the shortest-fuse local opportunity: contractors should identify participating GCs immediately and confirm whether HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire-protection, drywall, glazing, millwork and finish scopes are still open for pricing.
source: PlanHub — Bid #6859 First Baptist Church Cumming

title: Western Corridor Sanitary Sewer Improvements
size: New duplex submersible wastewater pumping station plus approximately 1,760 LF of gravity sanitary sewer and associated force mains, trenchless crossings, controls, electrical building, grading and restoration
timing: The official City of Cumming Utilities posting confirms bids are due September 17, 2026 at 10:00 AM. The mandatory pre-bid has already occurred, so new specialty contractors should target eligible bidding primes and suppliers rather than attempting to enter as a new prime. Cumming Utilities main office: 770-781-2020.
source: City of Cumming Utilities — RFPs and Bids
